claims.statement: A Zoom user-authorization or device OAuth flow returns a refresh_token with the access token; refresh tokens expire after 90 days and the latest one must be used for the next refresh request.

sources.supports: Refresh tokens expire after 90 days. You should always use the latest refresh token for the next refresh request.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Not researched beyond existence: prefix, alphabet, length and any checksum are not stated on the pages read, and no value shape may be inferred from the examples (docs examples are placeholders or illustrative).
Documentation examples show refresh_token as the placeholder <JWT_TOKEN>; the pages read give no structure.
The corresponding user-flow access token is not recorded as its own candidate here; whether it is a distinct family from the Server-to-Server access token needs a decision.
